items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe') and the subject as James Chirillo. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: James was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are at the IAJE in Manhattan filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton. I’m pleased to have James Chirillo with me tonight. It’s fairly late but for jazz musicians it’s about the time you’d normally start work.
